author: Bender (port)
InertSteak (Pokermon)
description: 145 Gen 1 Pokemon Jokers ported from Pokermon by InertSteak (GPLv3), with evolution and the evolution stones: the whole non-Mega Gen 1 roster except eight Jokers blocked on missing engine pieces (Chansey, Jynx, Ditto, Porygon, Snorlax, Moltres, Missingno, Farfetch'd; reasons in README.txt). Level, scaling and stone evolutions use the Balatro3DS fork (Tier 1 SMODS.add_card / SMODS.destroy_joker, plus SMODS.ConsumableType for the stones' poke_item type) and need the fork build (github.com/sen2008/balatro3ds-fork); on the stock game the pack loads and plays as before, but nothing evolves and no stones appear. Energy does not exist on 3DS, so each Pokemon keeps its base effect at base values. Five stones (Fire, Water, Thunder, Moon, and since v1.4.0 Leaf) evolve the Joker you choose (Tier 3 target_joker): 16 pre-forms in all, Eevee branching to Flareon, Vaporeon or Jolteon by stone. The pack also registers an Item Pack booster dealing stones (no wrapper art, so the engine's plain booster panel shows).
name: Pokermon (3DS port)
